factual_claims.claim: Real estate development performed better in volume terms: revenue rose 13.8% to EUR 73.4 million, apartment sales increased to 358 units worth EUR 67.8 million from 323 units worth EUR 58.9 million, and more than three times as many new apartments were started as in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment reporting: Real estate development revenue EUR 73,373 thousand (2025) vs EUR 64,492 thousand (2024) (+13.8%). Apartment sales: 358 units/EUR 67,800 thousand vs 323 units/EUR 58,900 thousand. New starts: 'In 2025 we were able to start construction of more than three times as many new apartments as in 2024' (page 64).

factual_claims.claim: Nevertheless, segment operating profit fell 18.8% to EUR 13.4 million and its margin declined to 18.2% from 25.5%, partly due to a EUR 1.0 million write-down, including a property in Norway.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment reporting: Real estate development operating profit EUR 13,364 thousand (2025) vs EUR 16,450 thousand (2024) (-18.8%). Margin: 18.2% vs 25.5%. Note 18: 'In 2025, inventories have been written down to their net realisable value by EUR 1,000 thousand (2024: EUR 0)' (page 29). Management report mentions Norway write-down (page 64).

factual_claims.claim: The secured construction order book rose 37.1% to EUR 466.9 million, following EUR 362.8 million of new contracts.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'As of 31 December 2025, the group’s secured order book stood at EUR 466,867 thousand (2024: EUR 340,589 thousand)... In 2025, new construction contracts worth EUR 362,800 thousand were signed' (page 66).

factual_claims.claim: Major awards included Rail Baltica projects and defence-related work.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Largest construction contracts signed in 2025 list Rail Baltica Ülemiste terminal (EUR 85.0m) and defence campus projects (page 66). Management report confirms these as major awards (page 66).

factual_claims.claim: Contracts for the Rūdninkai defence campus signed in early 2026 are expected to contribute gradually from 2026 onward.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'the second half of 2025 showed a clear improvement, and preparatory efforts resulted in new major contracts. The most extensive and thorough preparation was carried out by our Lithuanian colleagues and in the first days of the current year resulted in the signing of the largest contracts in Merko’s history for the construction of two phases of the Rūdninkai defence campus... Given their scale and nature, these contracts will begin to contribute to revenue gradually in 2026 and onwards' (page 54).

factual_claims.claim: Financial strength improved: equity rose to EUR 260.6 million, the equity ratio increased to 62.8% from 56.9%, and debt remained moderate at 8.0% of assets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position: Equity attributable to equity holders of the parent EUR 260,566 thousand (2025) vs EUR 254,258 thousand (2024). Equity ratio: 62.8% vs 56.9%. Debt ratio: 8.0% vs 7.5% (page 151).

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow was negative EUR 1.7 million, mainly reflecting higher inventories and working-capital movements, while cash declined to EUR 41.4 million after EUR 33.6 million of dividends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated cash flow statement: Operating cash flow (1,653) thousand EUR. Cash and cash equivalents: EUR 41,424 thousand (2025) vs EUR 91,879 thousand (2024). Dividends paid: EUR 33,630 thousand (page 153, 9).

factual_claims.claim: The Board proposed a further EUR 22.1 million dividend, or EUR 1.25 per share.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit allocation proposal: 'The Management Board proposes... Dividends (EUR 1.25 per share) 22,125,000' (page 9).
